questions.question:
**Directions: **Study the following information carefully answer the given questions.

A + B means A is the daughter of B.

A & B means A is the son of B.

A % B means A is the husband of B.

A @ B means A is the mother of B.

Which of the following expressions represents ‘F’ is the father in law of ‘I’?
questions.solution:
Members: F, G, H, and I.

Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree.

 
 

 
 
**A is**

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
%

 
 
 
@

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 
Son

 
 
 
husband

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 

 
 
**of B**

 
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efea675b7571f8cdebeb5d56bb5bb13749d80307f004fb70e1edf43114f14f1b.png] 

Let us check each option

1) F @ G % H @ I, means F is the mother of G, G is the husband of H and I is the daughter of G.

Thus, F will be the grandfather of I. Hence this option gets eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b6f8f45fce68cee6ad07953f0d55203dc3695c6cdd2df04dd3bcfa48c3f8cfd.png] 

2) G & H + I @ F, means I is the mother of F. Hence this option gets eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/285e5266c7ac4f449a469f0a8605d1b88f6f15150779f3dd25457ce3043598b0.png] 

3) F % G @ H % I, means F is the husband of G. G is the mother of H. H is the husband of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64f856ebcfd1ca8862b837775cb09534552fff098b7fe04d9ac7f7b1b759bfa5.png] 

Hence, F is the father in law of I.

4) I @ H % F + G, means I is the mother of H. H is the husband of F. Thus, I will be the mother in law of F. Hence this option gets eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb8da71490fd537850650046ba7745099d9ef9dfcb9e10013d35cc8575a12c4a.png] 

Hence, F % G @ H % I is the correct answer.

questions.question: The second number in the given number pairs is obtained by performing certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number. The same operation(s) are followed in all the number pairs, EXCEPT one. Find that odd number pair.
questions.solution:
Here, we need to find the pattern and get the missing number.

The logic here is: **(1st number × 3) + (1st number ÷ 3) = 2nd number.**

1) 93 times 3 + 31 = 310,

2) 54 times 3 + 18 = 180

3) 48 times 3 + 16 = 160 ne 165

4) 33 times 3 + 11 = 110

Thus, the pattern is: Each 1st is multiplied by 3 and then 2nd term first two digits are added to the answer to get the final answer.

Hence, the correct option is **48 - 165**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Logic: (1st number ÷ 3) × 10 = 2nd number.

1) (93 ÷ 3) × 10 → 31 × 10 = 310,

2) (54 ÷ 3) × 10 → 18 × 10 = 180,

3) (48 ÷ 3) × 10 → 16 × 10 = 160 ≠ 165

4) (33 ÷ 3) × 10 → 11 × 10 = 110.

questions.solution:
**Here the given logic is:**

**11 ÷ 2 = 5.5 + .5 = 6 ⇒ 6³ = __216__**

13 ÷ 2 = 6.5 + .5 = 7 ⇒ 7³ = 343

7 ÷ 2 = 3.5 + .5 = 4 ⇒ 4³ = 64

As per the given logic, the **correct answer is option 2,** as **11 : 49 **do not follow the pattern that other options do.

questions.question:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

What will come in place of question mark (?) in each of the following number series?

30, 45, ?, 275, 810
questions.solution:
The logic for the given series is mentioned below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/147aa5611c07d684162317d39b01c907cb07e2b6e9322d60de5e51b2cd10860d.png]

⇒ 30 × 3 = 90 - 45 = 45

⇒ 45 × 3 = 135 - 35 = __**100**__

⇒ 100 × 3 = 300 - 25 = 275

⇒ 275 × 3 = 825 - 15 = 810

Hence, the correct answer is **"100".**

questions.question: You are supposed to go by bus to your friend's wedding, but on reaching the bus stand you find that the only bus you wanted to catch is about to start and there is hardly any time to buy the ticket. The best thing for you is to:

options.text: Rush to the bus and start arguing with the conductor to get a seat
Rush to the bus rather, and inform the conductor about your inability to purchase the ticket
Miss the bus rather than take the risk of boarding the moving bus

questions.question:
Consider the following number sequence:

4 5 3 6 9 1 7 2 5 8 1 5 3 8 4 3 2 1 6 6 4 1

If all the odd numbers are eliminated from the sequence, which number is 4th to the left of the 9th number from extreme left end?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Odd numbers are not divisible by 2.

Given number sequence without odd numbers:

Left end 4 6 2 8 **8** 4 2 6 **6** 4 Right end

9th number from extreme left end = 6

4th to the left of 6 = 8

Hence, “8” is the correct answer.
